components.name: Usuario (#lUser)
components.action: Free-text input for the account/username. No placeholder-derived <label>; only a placeholder attribute ('Usuario') is present, so screen-reader users get no accessible name unless the placeholder is announced by the AT.

components.name: Password (#lPass)
components.action: Free-text password input, placeholder 'Password' only (no <label>, no aria-label).

components.name: Remember me (#checkbox-signup)
components.action: Toggles a 'remember me' preference; checked by default on page load. Purpose/behavior (session length? saved username?) not verified — no visible effect tested.

components.name: Entrar
components.action: An <a href="#" onclick="login()"> (not a real button/submit element). Triggers JS login() which POSTs credentials; on success shows an intermediate 'Loading https://.../Rastreo.aspx' document title for ~4-20s, then redirects to Rastreo.aspx.

components.name: Recuperar mi Contraseña?
components.action: <a href="#" onclick="Recuperar();">. Presumed password-recovery flow; not exercised further in this phase (out of scope — would likely send a real email).

components.name: Crear Cuenta Gratis
components.action: Real link, href="NuevaCuenta.aspx". Navigates to the public registration screen.

components.name: Page title 'Domipack - Web Trans'
components.action: Static branding text, not a live status message on this screen.

notes: Root '/' renders the same markup as this screen directly (no redirect observed).

Both primary form fields (#lUser, #lPass) rely on placeholder text as their only visible label — no <label for> or aria-label, which is an accessibility gap (placeholder text disappears once the field has a value or focus, in some browsers/AT configurations).
